title: Samples Workbench Cafe Standup — Jun 18 2026
content:
Attendees: Asha (notes), Miguel, Evelyn, Samir, Priya (Product), Joel (Solutions eng briefly)

Goal: quick sync on Samples Workbench features, language quickstarts, and upcoming SDK-friendly templates before demo next sprint. Keep it short — focus blockers and concrete owners.

1) Quick status rundown
- Samples Workbench app: staging deploy stable, smoke tests passing (local + CI). Observed flaky test in python-quickstart runner (~10% failures, pytest timeout).
- JS quickstart: doc rewrite in progress, removed complex auth example per security feedback — now uses short-lived token flow.
- Go example: prototype PR open but needs packaging instructions for modules, discovered version pin issue with go-sqlite driver.
- Template catalog: added 6 new microtemplates (chat, summarization, reranker, embeddings-batch, streaming-example, function-calling-skeleton).

2) Blockers (high priority)
- Python runner flakes: cause seems to be concurrency in test harness (race between local cache warmup + mock server start). Miguel to add deterministic start/wait logic. Ticket: JIRA-DX-472. ETA: 2d.
- JS auth snippet removed but docs still reference old flow in quickstarts page. Evelyn to PR doc fix (#314) by EOD Thu.
- Go quickstart: module version pin required for reproducible build across dev machines — Samir to update go.mod and add CI build check. ETA: Fri 6/25.

3) Usability feedback from 3 devs in playtest
- Confusing file layout for multi-language examples — request: single top-level README with TL;DR, per-language TOC.
- Suggestion: add a one-minute video GIF for each quickstart showing request -> response to reduce cognitive load. Priya says marketing can help produce 6 short clips next sprint.

4) Metrics & telemetry
- Quickstarts instrumented to emit: sample_run.started, sample_run.finished, sample_run.error. Initial dashboards show ~450 runs/week; error rate ~2.1% dominated by python runner flakiness.
- Action: add a label for 'demo' vs 'automated-test' to be able to filter playtest noise. Joel will add tagging to the samples runner via env var. ETA: 3 days.

5) Docs and onboarding
- Quickstart flow now standardized: 1) create API key 2) install SDK 3) run example 4) inspect tokens/cost breakdown in Console. Need one small page mapping Redwood Console UX to quickstart outputs — Evelyn to draft and link to console screenshots.
- Add a troubleshooting mini-FAQ for the top 5 errors (auth, timeouts, model-not-found, dependency mismatch, streaming cutoffs). Asha to assemble initial FAQ from Slack threads.

6) Release gating and checklist for demo
- Must have: non-flaky python quickstart, updated docs + screenshot, 1 runable example per language (py/js/go), GIFs for 3 highlighted examples, smoke-tests green in CI.
- Risk: if python flaky tests persist, we feature-flag python quickstart from demo and show recorded run. Decision reserved by Thurs review.

7) Open questions / notes to self
- Do we want to standardize on one example model (e.g., redwood/opt-1) across all quickstarts to make token-cost comparisons consistent? (Pros: easier benchmarking; Cons: hides model differences). Tagging for follow-up.
- Consider adding tiny e2e cost estimator in README (est. tokens and price) — helpful for sales/field.

8) Action items (owner — due)
- Miguel: fix python runner race (JIRA-DX-472) — due 2026-06-20
- Evelyn: PR doc fixes for JS auth & draft Console mapping page (PR #314) — due 2026-06-19
- Samir: update go.mod, add CI build check — due 2026-06-25
- Joel: add 'demo' tag env var and update sample-run telemetry — due 2026-06-21
- Asha: compile troubleshooting FAQ + starter section for one-minute GIF todo list — due 2026-06-22
- Priya: coordinate marketing for GIFs (6 clips) and prioritize 3 for demo — check-in 2026-06-24

9) Meeting wrap / next sync
- Quick asynchronous updates in #devexp-samples Slack channel; next live sync Fri 2026-06-25 (15m) to confirm demo readiness.

Misc notes (choppy):
- local note: look into fsnotify vs polling for sample runner file-watch (causes flaky warmup) — try using HTTP readiness probe instead of file presence.
- remember: update quickstart license headers to match company CLA template.

References:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/314
- Jira: JIRA-DX-472
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD-1742
